narrative.overview:
LiveAgentsView stages coding agents as a party at camp, never as a status table. A session that is `working` leaves for a quest and appears only in the left quest sidebar as a compact token. Every other activity — `waiting`, `failed`, `ready` — returns to camp: a Pixi scene with ember dusk ground, a hard fire, tents/trees, and procedural 16-bit kits that patrol on a shared grid. Urgency is staging: urgent agents walk nearer the flame at full opacity with distinct WAITING/FAILED glyphs and ground rings; calm agents sit further back, dimmed (`alpha ≈ 0.82` in Pixi; `brightness(0.8) saturate(0.85)` on DOM stands). Select opens a resizable right drawer that never covers the party.

Chrome is wood panels with hard SNES bevels (inset highlight/lowlight + thick wood borders), not classic Final Fantasy blue menu fill. Party art is code-baked pixel kits (`camp/defs` → Pixi textures / canvas portraits), not hand PNGs and not legacy SVG rect sprites as the shipping path. Jersey 15 owns short HUD strings; Work Sans owns anything read at length. There are no fake HP/MP bars under party members — resource cosplay was removed by design.
keyCharacteristics: Attention is staging: quest sidebar = working; camp = everyone else
Ember-wood SNES bevel chrome over parchment read surfaces
Pixi camp + procedural kits (race/class readable across the room)
Urgency by row + distinct WAITING/FAILED cues — never color alone
Jersey 15 HUD / Work Sans long-read split; no party HP/MP chrome

rules.name: The Firelight Proximity Rule
rules.body: Urgency is position + brightness + a WAITING or FAILED glyph (and ring). Calm agents dim and sit further from the fire. Do not invent a badge count or red-dot urgency system.

rules.name: The Ember-Wood Rule
rules.body: HUD chrome is wood + ember bevels. Do not paint menus in classic blue FF fill; blue may appear only as kit cloth/metal inside procedural sprites.

rules.name: The Parchment-Is-Reading Rule
rules.body: Dark wood/ember for camp and chrome; switch to parchment the moment content is read at length (chat, details, recruit ledger, forms).

rules.name: The No Fake Meters Rule
rules.body: Party stands and quest tokens do not show HP/MP or token-consumption bars. Do not revive resource cosplay under kits.

rules.name: The Chrome-Only Pixel Rule
rules.body: Jersey 15 only on short controlled strings via .pixel-face or explicit Jersey on buttons — always font-weight: 400 (single shipped weight). Never on transcript, inputs, or free-length copy.

rules.name: The Hard-Edge Rule
rules.body: Depth offsets stay crisp integers with zero or near-zero blur. Soft ambient UI shadows are out of world.

dos: Do keep Jersey 15 on short HUD strings at weight 400; Work Sans for long read.
Do use wood SNES bevels (bevel-hi / bevel-lo) on chrome and primary actions.
Do stage urgency with camp row + WAITING/FAILED glyphs/rings — never color alone.
Do bake party art through the procedural kit path shared by Pixi and Portrait.
Do switch to parchment for transcript, details, recruit, and forms.
Do keep the session drawer as a side panel that leaves the party visible.
donts: Don't revive HP/MP (or fake token meters) under party stands or quest tokens.
Don't paint HUD chrome in classic blue Final Fantasy menu fill.
Don't replace the Pixi + kit baker path with legacy SVG rect party sprites as the shipping art.
Don't put Jersey 15 on body copy, transcript, or uncontrolled-length strings.
Don't use soft blurred elevation shadows or rounded card language (border-radius stays 0).
Don't let the drawer or recruit flow become a status table that replaces the camp staging.
